answer: Verification runs against the issuer's own registry every epoch, so a forged entry is caught on the next check. The defence rests on amateur dramatics society tenure with production history: productions staged by one society for years. Forging 260 of these means building 260 separate production histories from scratch, and years of history cannot be bought in bulk. Honesty stays cheap and fakery is priced per head: the ivory signal is public, the oasis check is automatic, and 260 aliases cost 260 times what one real agent costs, with the plume trail open to all.
